messages:
maria: Kicking off a 30m soak in staging to validate per-org + per-key burst regeneration and quota enforcement. Running mixed traffic across ~50 orgs. Sharing config and will post findings.
liam: ack. which generator and flags?
maria: using qa-load from infra sandbox. Command:
```
./qa-load --env=staging --duration=30m --mode=burst --qps=200 --org-count=50 --keys-per-org=3 --burst-window=60s --regen-rate=10/s --header=X-API-Key
```
shreya: dashboard link for quick reference: https://console.redwood.local/dashboards/rate_limiter?env=staging (panel: 429s by org, token-bucket fill %)
jonathan: seeing initial 429 spike around 1771234720 in the canary. Posting a sampled log:
```
2026-03-18T12:12:01Z INFO rate_limiter hit org=org-17 key=key-3 reason=burst_quota_exceeded tokens_left=0 window=60s
```
maria: ok that's the bucket depletion signal. Expect some 429s early as caches warm and buckets refill.
liam: note: staging doesn't have fallback routing enabled (only prod). If buckets empty we just 429 right now. We should simulate fallback to a cheaper model to measure UX.
maria: can we toggle the simulated fallback flag in staging for this run? I want to see error rate vs correctness.
sre-bot: deploy-bot: rate-limiter-config v2026-03-18-01 rolled to canary at 1771234800 by shreya :rocket:
shreya: updated rate-limiter config in staging (per-org overrides enabled). Current policy snippet:
```
{"policy":"token_bucket","burst_size":120,"regen_per_sec":10,"per_org_override":true}
```
maria: proposing bump regen_per_sec -> 20 and burst_size -> 240 for next 30m to mimic expected prod traffic patterns. Also add alert: sustained 429 > 5% for 5m.
liam: +1 to bump, and add Retry-After header on 429s for better client UX.
jonathan: telemetry question: are we tagging metrics with org_id and key_hash? We need per-key heatmap for this test.
maria: yes metrics include org_id + key_hash, but sampling rate for low-qps keys is small. I'll request an increased capture for keys > 10 qps.
shreya: updated dashboard: added 429 per-org heatmap and token-bucket fill % chart. link: https://console.redwood.local/dashboards/rate_limiter/heatmap
qa-load: starting adjusted run now with regen=20/s and burst=240; command mirrored in logs.
maria: running 30m. I'll post quick summary after completion. Early numbers: peak qps ~5k, average sustained ~3k for 10m window.
jonathan: small note: seeing some 500s from grpc-proxy when 429 cascade happens. Might be upstream backpressure, filing an issue.
maria: soak complete. Short summary: 30m run with adjusted regen/burst. 429s dropped from ~8% -> ~1.2% after config change. Token-bucket refill behavior matched expectations for most orgs; 3 outlier orgs hit sustained >10% 429s due to very bursty single-key traffic.
liam: good. next steps: 1) run prod-topology test (multiple regions + cross-region fallback), 2) enable simulated fallback to cheaper model in staging and measure end-to-end latency + quality, 3) improve telemetry sampling for high-cardinality keys, 4) add Retry-After header + UX change in API docs.
maria: I'll file a follow-up with exact run artifacts and the list of outlier orgs (sanitized) and open a small PR for Retry-After header.
shreya: I'll schedule a 1h soak next week with cross-region mix. Will also add an alert for sustained 429 > 5% and a dashboard widget for top 10 keys by 429s.
deploy-bot: canary promotion queued for rate-limiter-config v2026-03-18-02 pending QA verification.
maria: thanks everyone. tagging @oncall for visibility. :white_check_mark:
